messages:
Devin (ENG): Hey @Asha — quick question about short-term childcare while I’m on a staggered parental return. Partner will be primary caregiver for 6 weeks, I’ll take 2 weeks leave and then a phased return. Is there a childcare subsidy for this, and can we request temporary contractor funding to cover the first 6 weeks?

Asha (People Ops): Congrats! :party_parrot: Short answers: yes, there’s a short-term childcare reimbursement for unexpected coverage + yes, managers can request temporary contract/backfill funding for parental coverage. I’ll outline the steps below.

Asha (People Ops): Eligibility & docs: 1) Employee must be on approved parental leave or phased-return plan; 2) Receipts required within 60 days of expense; 3) Subsidy cap = $1,200 total per parental event (check policy for country-specific limits). Submit via the Parental Benefits form (link: https://hr.internal.redwood/parental-benefits).

Asha (People Ops): Temporary backfill funding: manager needs to submit a short "temporary headcount request" to People Ops + Recruiting with: role summary, expected duration (weeks), weekly hours, and estimated budget. People Ops will review and route to Finance for one-time approval.

Asha (People Ops): Quick checklist you’ll need:
- Completed parental leave approval (HR case #)
- Phased return schedule (dates & % FTE)
- Receipts for childcare (photo/scan ok)
- Manager approval for contractor spend

Asha (People Ops): Example backfill request text your manager can paste to Recruiting:```Hi Recruiting — requesting a 6-week temporary contractor to cover feature delivery during Devin's parental overlap. Role: Senior ML infra engineer (contractor). Scope: maintain inference pipelines and on-call coverage. Duration: 6 weeks, ~30 hours/week. Budget: up to $9k. Approved by manager: Jordan. Please advise timeline and next steps.```

Jordan (Manager): I support this. Devin, can you send me the phased return dates and an estimate of the core tasks that need coverage? I'll include approval and budget estimate when I ping recruiting.

Lina (Hiring): Tagging @recruiting-ops would help. Also please include a one-paragraph role description and any must-have skills. We can often post a contractor job within 48–72 hours after approval.

Devin (ENG): Thanks all. Quick follow-ups: 1) Are childcare reimbursements taxable? 2) Can we request subsidy retroactively for expenses from last week?

Asha (People Ops): Good q's — 1) Tax treatment depends on country/state — in the US most reimbursements are non-taxable if through the company benefits program, but Finance will confirm on approving the request. 2) Yes, retroactive claims are allowed up to 60 days from the date of expense, so last week's receipts are fine.

PeopleOpsBot: New HR case opened: HR-2026-482. Please include this case number on the Parental Benefits form.

Devin (ENG): I’ll fill the form now and add the receipts, plus send phased return dates to Jordan. Thanks for the template, Asha — that helps a lot :thumbsup:

Asha (People Ops): No problem — ping me if you want me to draft the recruiting request or review the receipts before you submit. Good luck and congrats again! :baby::heart:
